source_name: Cross-checked 2026-11-20: NSE holiday-master API and NIFTY option-chain expiries; RBI MPC FY27 schedule press release; Federal Reserve FOMC calendar; BLS release schedules (CPI, Employment Situation, JOLTS, PPI); BEA release schedule; MoSPI Advance Release Calendar 2026-27. Covers 2026-11-20 to 2026-12-29.

events.name: NIFTY monthly expiry, November series (also BANKNIFTY monthly; moved: 24-Nov is a holiday)
events.impact_note: Monthly F&O expiry advanced to Monday because Tuesday 24-Nov is a trading holiday; rollover day.

events.name: NSE/BSE trading holiday - Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev
events.impact_note: Exchange closed; no cash or derivatives trading.

events.name: US GDP Q3 2026 second estimate and October PCE inflation
events.impact_note: 08:30 ET = 19:00 IST, after Indian close; PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge.

events.name: US market holiday - Thanksgiving
events.source: NYSE holiday rule (fourth Thursday of November), BEA schedule notes Thanksgiving 26-Nov (checked 2026-11-20)
events.impact_note: US markets shut; thin global cues for the 27-Nov Indian session.

events.name: India IIP (Oct 2026) release
events.source: MoSPI Advance Release Calendar 2026-27 (updated till October 2026) (checked 2026-11-20)
events.impact_note: Saturday release; reaction at the 30-Nov open.

events.name: India GDP Q2 FY2026-27 (Jul-Sep) estimate

events.impact_note: Released 16:00 IST after the close; drives the 01-Dec open and rate-sensitive sectors.

events.name: US JOLTS job openings (Oct 2026)
events.source: BLS Schedule of Selected Releases 2026, bls.gov (checked 2026-11-20)
